species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 46°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–20 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northeast wind at 25 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
